About SurferFX, Surfer Quant and its global network

SurferFX is the website of Surfer Quant, known in Chinese as 冲浪者量化 and 冲浪者AI量化. The team works across strategy research, global market information, trading signals and AI infrastructure.

OUR PERSPECTIVE

Markets keep changing.
Research never stands still.

Our business perspective spans FX, gold, futures, equities and digital assets. Research and services across these areas provide a gateway for professional traders, institutions and technology partners.

We value explainable strategy logic, traceable records and continued attention to operating conditions and risk.
